last_review.summary: HTML parsing and JavaScript syntax checks passed, and Node checks exercised seating counts, purchase and reset handlers, share search, and A2 vector PDFs in all three styles. CSV recovery and dependency scope failed, and Chromium’s read-only profile error left live offline behavior, 390 px layout, downloads, and phone scanning unverified.
issues: Fix CSV error recovery so an unclosed quoted row followed immediately by a valid quoted multiline name imports the valid record and reports only the malformed row. The current parser drops the valid multiline guest and reports a second error on its closing line.

Restore the planned five-file scope and use system and built-in PDF fonts with the existing PDF and QR libraries. Remove the added Fontkit dependency, embedded font assets, landing page, and sample images, and update the app to remove its references to those additions.
